correctness.rationale: The shell count 6 times binomial(5,r) per landmark follows by projecting each of the six parallel edge directions to Q₅. Summing the weighted histogram therefore forces total weight 84m. A fresh exact enumeration of all six-component histograms with total m and the only active capacities h₀,h₅ at most 2 reproduced the weight counts for m=6 as 7,12,27,36,54,60 and for m=7 as 8,14,32,44,68,80, giving minimum total weights 670 and 612 for 192 distinct histograms, respectively. These exceed the forced totals 504 and 588, ruling out m=6,7. Combined with the prior lower bound excluding smaller sets, this proves edim_m(Q₆) at least 8.
residual_risks: The proof uses the previously published lower bound of 6 to dispose of m below 6; that prior result was checked at the primary-source level.
